title.en: Polarization: the wave carries the antenna's direction

concept.hr: E leži u ravnini žice i spojnice; prijamni dipol uzima cos ψ
concept.en: E lies in the plane of the wire and the line of sight; a receiver takes cos ψ

summary.hr: Dva kratka dipola na 1 km. Okreni prijamni: napon pada s cos, snaga s cos², pri 90° ništa. Uzduž žice nema zračenja. Isti napon u oba smjera.
summary.en: Two short dipoles 1 km apart. Turn the receiver: voltage falls as cos, power as cos², nothing at 90°. Nothing along the wire. The same voltage both ways.
